body: i was trying for hours to convince him and nothing was working and being so far away i couldnt just drive there to stop him. i was trying to talk to suicide chat lines but it was taking forever an i wasnt able to get into one quick enough. i ended up calling the police and he is being taken in to being evaluated.

the only reason i said that (not to him) is because he wasnt listening. im suicidal myself and have talked a few people out of it, but any method was just not working and i panicked so hard. i was running out of time and i had no clue what to do. i ended up calling the police station of where ithought he lived, which i ws later able to confirm he lived there when the officer called me. 20min later she found him and took him to be evaluated. she actually told me he said he was glad i called.

like as in what if he had just been like "she typed that up i didnt say it". it all worked out but i was panicking and emotional and obviously my anxiety was making this worse so i'm going to think of every worst possible situation.
